name: Muhammed Umair
philosophy: Build with curiosity. Engineer with logic. Create with purpose.
about: Muhammed Umair, professionally known as UMXIE, is a software developer passionate about building modern web applications, scalable backend systems, AI-powered solutions, and creative digital experiences. His interests include backend engineering, full-stack development, JavaScript, software architecture, database management, artificial intelligence, 3D web development, UI/UX design, and creative technology. He enjoys learning through real-world projects, solving technical problems, exploring emerging technologies, and continuously improving his software engineering skills.
